summary: Verified primary bug fix: creating a NEW brand and generating landing page with model=gpt now succeeds end-to-end. Both backend pytest (4/4 pass) and Playwright UI flow confirm the regression is resolved.

verification_details.backend_pytest: 4/4 pass in 43s - test_brand_appears_in_list, test_landingpage_gpt_with_new_brand, test_copy_gpt_with_new_brand, test_social_gpt_with_new_brand
verification_details.active_brand_switch: active-brand-trigger dropdown -> brand-option-<id> works; header reflects 'Aktive Marke: TEST_FE_Tierarzt...'
verification_details.landing_generation: POST /api/generate/landingpage with model=gpt returns 200; UI renders 4029-char result containing headline/subtitle/Vorteile/FAQ/SEO/Preise. NO 'Etwas ist schiefgelaufen' toast.
verification_details.copy_generation: POST /api/generate/copy with model=gpt returns 200; copy-result rendered
verification_details.social_generation: POST /api/generate/social with model=gpt returns 200; Facebook & LinkedIn posts rendered, brand-aware content (Tierarztpraxis, Welpenimpfung hashtags) confirmed
verification_details.brand_context_in_output: Generated social posts reference 'TEST_FE_Tierarzt_13131' brand name and tierarzt-themed hashtags - active brand context flowing through correctly

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 862 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold for splitting into modules (brands.py, generation.py, funnel.py). Not blocking but worth refactoring.

_api_key_for(provider) only routes 'openai' to the user key - 'anthropic' (claude) still uses the exhausted Emergent key by design. Reviewer should confirm this is intentional (per agent_to_agent_context_note: yes, Claude path is known to fail until budget topped up).

Default fallback model in llm_text uses 'claude' (MODEL_MAP.get(model_choice, MODEL_MAP['claude'])) - if anyone passes an unknown model string it will hit the exhausted Emergent key. Consider defaulting to 'gpt' to align with the new frontend default.
seed_data_creation: Created one persisted test brand 'TEST_FE_Tierarzt_13131' in MongoDB via UI for the flow; backend pytest brands are cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. OPENAI_API_KEY route works. Do NOT test claude model or image (Nano Banana) - those go through exhausted Emergent key by design. data-testids used: brand-new-btn, brand-input-name/tone/imgstyle, brand-save-btn, brand-card-<id>, active-brand-trigger, brand-option-<id>, model-trigger (shows 'GPT-5.2'), landing-topic-input, landing-generate-btn, landing-result, copy-*, social-*. Note: 'platform-Instagram' testid exists but is button-style toggle (Facebook/LinkedIn were defaults).
rca of the issue: Original bug ('Etwas ist schiefgelaufen' on new-brand + landingpage generation) was not brand-specific - it was caused by Emergent universal LLM key budget exhaustion (Max budget 1.0). Fix: added OPENAI_API_KEY in backend/.env and routed the 'openai' provider in _api_key_for() to that key. Frontend default model switched to 'gpt'. Verified: backend pytest 4/4 pass, UI shows GPT-5.2 default, full landing/copy/social generation succeeds with a freshly-created brand.
